predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. For the most part, the week 1 picks went well, as I posted a pretty stout 20-7 (74.1% correct) record. But what did NOT go well was anything at all to do with frickin' stupid F div… 0-3 in that mess. Crap. == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (G Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Rippin Darts. The week 2 matchup with the highest-scoring pairing leaguewide is maybe an early G title-match preview. I gotta stay with Rippin here, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Liquor Possee @ Bottoms Up. Only E managed to squeeze teams a touch closer than B did in week 1, and matchups like this could be critical three months from now. I'll go Possee, just 13-11.

Match #3: (D Div.) Dart Knights @ Nine Lives. The week 1 D winners all put up decent scores, so an immediate pairing of two of them means something has to give right early here. I'll ride with the Knights, 14-10.

Match #4: (C Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Projectile Dysfunction. C is the only one of the three 8-team divisions where the four 1-0 teams all face each other. Big week already. Projectile reels them in, 13-11.

Match #5: (F Div.) Two Time @ Nein Mark. Nein yanked one from the fire last week, and I think they might need to do it again this week. I wasn't sure what to do with the new Two Time, but good so far, 14-10.

Match #6: (C Div.) Area 501 @ Mulligans Mafia. I have a feeling this is another really key C match just two weeks in. I'm not hopping off the Area train or anything, but Mafia will be tight all season. Area, 14-10.

Match #7: (A Div.) Appetite for Destruction @ Wing & A Plaque. Wing got the super clutch win last week, but Appetite was running around dropping hammers. Appetite is here for the long haul, 18-6. == Two 0-1 Teams ==
Match #8: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ Shark Shooters. Not sure how the Cheapies let it slip last week. But to be fair, I'm sure of exactly nothing in F, sooo… I'll doom the Cheapies, picking them 13-11.
Match #9: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Brutha Ducks. The Secrets were so close to joining the 1-0 group, while the Ducks were right with Area all the way. Tough travels in C land. Secrets, 13-11.
Match #10: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Darty Sanchez. I would guess these two planned on more than 4 total cricket points between them last week. Someone has to win them tonight… Sanchez, 14-10.

Match #11: (C Div.) Pints and Points @ Still Hump'N. The Pints got better as the night went on last week, but their comeback ran out of time. I'm thinking they keep that ramp up right into week 2, 15-9.
Match #12: (B Div.) The Kids Who Say "Ni!" @ Angry Birds. Ridgway is a bit of a beast lately, but I'm flying with the Birds, 13-11.
Match #13: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Darty Minds. Attack narrowly fell last week, while Darty had to deal with Appetite. Attack, 15-9.
Match #14: (G Div.) Aim-ing For Trouble @ Cary On Our Wayward Darts. Slow start for these two… somebody rebounds. Aim, 13-11.
